text: Figure 3.39: Modeling of the PhmRecoveryActionInterface As already mentioned, the application software is supposed to implement the recovery action. This implies that the PhmRecoveryActionInterface can only be used in combination with a PPortPrototype. This aspect is clarified by [constr_1729]. [constr_1729]{DRAFT} Qualified combinations of PortPrototypes and PhmRe- coveryActionInterface on application software level⌈Within the context of an Executable of category APPLICATION_LEVEL the usage of PhmRecoveryAc- tionInterface is only supported for a PPortPrototype.⌋() The ClientServerOperation that represents the actual recovery action shall be modeled as a void-void function, i.e. the ClientServerOperation is not supposed to return anything and it also shall not have any arguments regardless of their direction. Any information the recovery action needs for executing the recovery shall be provided using other mechanisms. This restriction is formalized by [constr_1730]. [constr_1730]{DRAFT} Restriction regarding the modeling of the PhmRecovery- ActionInterface.recovery⌈The ClientServerOperation aggregated in the role PhmRecoveryActionInterface.recovery shall fulfill the following conditions: • It shall not aggregate any arguments. • It shall not refer to any possibleApErrors. • It shall not refer to any possibleApErrorSets. 130 of 826 — AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL — Document ID 713: AUTOSAR_TPS_ManifestSpecification
